description: This file defines various TypedDict classes and type aliases used for real-time response handling, transformations, and query parameters in a language modeling or AI-related system. It also imports external dependencies and specific classes from the openai module.

classes.name: RealtimeResponseTransformInput
classes.description: TypedDict for input parameters related to transforming real-time responses, including session info and delta chunks.

classes.name: RealtimeResponseTypedDict
classes.description: TypedDict representing the structure of a typed response for real-time outputs, supporting multiple event types.

classes.name: RealtimeModalityResponseTransformOutput
classes.description: TypedDict for output when transforming modality responses, including returned messages and context IDs.

classes.name: RealtimeQueryParams
classes.description: TypedDict for query parameters used when requesting real-time responses, including model and intent.
